messages:
sophia: Heads up — VaultCloud + FortiKey want a joint launch with us. target date 2025-05-10. We need an SSO/SCIM + KMS/HSM checklist and marketplace listing draft. Who owns the integration playbook?
raj: I can own the tech playbook. I'll pair with elena on partner requirements.
elena: thanks @raj. I'll own partner comms + legal check-ins. @tim can you slot marketplace copy review? :handshake:
tim: yep, I can do marketplace copy and run the announcement timeline. need final feature matrix by EOD Thurs.
leo: security review note — FortiKey HSM needs our CMK rotation policy and attestation docs before we go live. I can draft the attestation template.
anya: sales ask — can we add a short FAQ about encrypted-at-rest vs customer-managed keys? sales cycles ask for that.
vendor-bob: Vendor side: we'll provide SAML metadata and SCIM test tenant. SAML endpoint: https://sso.vaultcloud.example/saml/metadata. SCIM base: https://scim.vaultcloud.example/v2/
elena: perfect. @vendor-bob can you also share a staging cert for SAML so we can run full e2e?
vendor-bob: yes, uploading to partner-share now. will ping when done.
raj: tech checklist draft (short):
- SAML: metadata ingest, IdP tests (login, logout), attribute mapping (email, name, groups)
- SCIM: PATCH/PUT provisioning, 2xx responses, bulk-delete safety checks
- KMS/HSM: customer CMK wrap/unwrap, import flow, key rotation test
- Secrets manager integration: secret sync latency, lease TTL semantics
- E2E: staging tenant + 50-user smoke test
- Rollout: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with auto-fallback
leo: add: audit log ingestion sample & key compromise playbook.
sophia: good. can we get owners inline? raj = tech playbook, elena = partner comms, tim = marketplace, leo = security, anya = sales FAQ. vendor-bob = staging artifacts.
raj: I'll drop the playbook into the partnerships drive by tomorrow morning and link it here.
infra-bot: CI status for repo redwood/vaultcloud-integration: all checks passed on branch integration/stage (build #428).
elena: legal ask — embargo until 2025-05-10 17:00 PT. please don't publicize before that.
tim: noted. I'll schedule marketplace publish for 2025-05-10 17:15 PT, post-embargo.
anya: can marketing get 1-pager + screenshot by next Tue?
elena: vendor will provide logos and a screenshot. @vendor-bob please drop assets in partner-share by Monday.
vendor-bob: will do.
raj: quick config snippet for SAML attribute mapping we tested:```
{
  "email": "urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3",
  "name": "urn:oid:2.5.4.3",
  "groups": "urn:oid:1.2.840.113556.1.4.1941"
}
```
leo: thanks. I'll run the attestation draft against that mapping.
sophia: action items recap:
- raj: publish tech playbook + run staging smoke test (due: tomorrow)
- elena: coordinate legal + collect assets (due: Mon)
- tim: draft marketplace copy + schedule publish (due: Thurs)
- leo: security attestation + audit playbook (due: Thurs)
- anya: sales FAQ draft (due: Fri)
- vendor-bob: upload SAML cert, logos, staging data (due: Mon)
All: please react with :thumbsup: when you accept items.
raj: :thumbsup:
elena: :thumbsup:
tim: :thumbsup:
leo: :thumbsup:
anya: :thumbsup:
vendor-bob: :thumbsup:
sophia: thanks everyone — will run a quick sync Wed 10am PT if we need it. if not, we'll use this thread for updates.
